content: भीषण {%a.%} [भी-णिच्-सुक् ल्यु] Terrific, formidable, dreadful, horrible, frightening; बिभ्युर्बिडालेक्षणभीषणाभ्यः <ls>Śi. 3. 45</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 The sentiment of terror (in rhetoric); see भयानक. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²3 A pigeon, dove. .²4 The olibanum tree. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Anything that excites terror. .²2 Terrifying, causing terror.
